100% Privacy & Zero Tracking:
• No personal data: This app does not collect, process, store, or transmit any identifying characteristics, device IDs, or advertising IDs.
• No trackers or SDKs: Neither Google Analytics, Firebase, nor advertising networks are integrated.
• Local storage: Configured preferences (location, units, auto-refresh interval) remain strictly local within private SharedPreferences on your device.
• Direct API connection: Weather queries are fetched directly via encrypted HTTPS from api.open-meteo.com without intermediate relay servers.
• Data subject rights: Users have rights of access, rectification, and erasure under Arts. 15–21 GDPR. Uninstalling the app or clearing its app storage completely removes all local data.
100% Free & Open-Source Software (GPL-3.0) • No trackers, no ads, no relay servers.
